Applicability.description: An evidenced selection condition, independent of the worker target.
Applicability.title: Applicability

Declaration.description: A source requirement/constraint, separately from package enumeration.
Declaration.title: Declaration

DependencySelector.description:
Located lock selector, including those without an unambiguous endpoint.

A resolved selector evidences a source edge, never installed reachability.
The adapter proves range/dialect selection within the same lock input.
DependencySelector.title: DependencySelector

InputReference.description: Located include/constraint provenance, never a dependency edge.
InputReference.title: InputReference

LicenseGap.description:
No input the producer read states a license for this occurrence.

Distinct from an observed ``NOASSERTION`` or ``NONE``, which is a claim.
LicenseGap.title: LicenseGap

LicenseObservation.description:
A located license claim about one occurrence, never an inference.

A declared manifest license is the project's claim about itself and
package metadata is the published package's claim; neither is the license
of a built artifact. ``evidence`` keeps them apart and nothing merges them.
Conflicting observations for one occurrence are all retained.
LicenseObservation.title: LicenseObservation
